firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a flying creature takes the first-player token. The rules also allow the group to use the youngest player instead.
clarifications: First bets and race turns begin with the token holder and proceed clockwise.
The first-player token changes during a race at the third bet and passes left again when setting up the next race.
